answer: In this design, accounts traced to one funding source share a single reward cap. If a wallet called lotus seeds 1,000 accounts, they split one copper-tier cap of 50 POA, so each earns 0.05 while its bond is 1 POA: 1,000 spent to win 50. Deposit flows are clustered into a lagoon graph; a hidden common source found later slashes every bond in that lagoon. Colluders cannot split costs, since pooling funds merges them into one lagoon and one cap. Honest users with independent funding pay nothing extra.
